# SBI Growth Advisory

> > AI-native revenue growth advisory firm providing GTM strategy, sales optimization, marketing effectiveness, customer success, and predictive intelligence to drive sustainable revenue growth.

SBI Growth Advisory is a specialized advisory firm focused on helping companies optimize their go-to-market strategy and revenue operations through AI-powered insights and proven methodologies. The firm combines strategic consulting across sales, marketing, customer success, and pricing with its proprietary Wayforge™ AI intelligence platform to deliver measurable revenue growth outcomes.

## Key Topics

- GTM Strategy
- Revenue Intelligence
- AI Analytics
- Sales Optimization
- Customer Success
- Pricing Strategy
- Performance Analytics
- Predictive Segmentation
- Territory Management
- Revenue Operations
- Sales Enablement
- Talent Lifecycle
- Wayforge Platform
- PE Due Diligence
- Business Intelligence

## Wayforge™ AI Intelligence Platform

- [Wayforge - AI-Powered Revenue Intelligence Platform](https://sbigrowth.com/wayforge): SBI Wayforge: AI revenue intelligence platform for GTM optimization & growth insights
- [SBI Wayforge™ Segmentation](https://sbigrowth.com/wayforge-segmentation): Wayforge Segmentation: dynamic account segmentation, ICP definition & predictive scoring
- [SBI Wayforge™ Churn](https://sbigrowth.com/wayforge-churn): Wayforge Churn: predictive analytics for at-risk customer identification & retention
- [SBI Wayforge™ Talent](https://sbigrowth.com/wayforge-talent): Wayforge Talent: AI-powered talent intelligence & performance prediction for hiring
- [SBI Wayforge™ Diligence](https://sbigrowth.com/wayforge-diligence): Wayforge Diligence: commercial intelligence & GTM analysis for M&A deal evaluation

- [SBI Growth Advisory - AI-Native Revenue Growth Advisory](https://sbigrowth.com): SBI Growth Advisory homepage: AI-powered GTM strategy, sales, marketing, pricing & CS optimization

- [GTM Due Diligence Services | SBI Growth Advisory](https://sbigrowth.com/services/gtm-due-diligence): GTM due diligence for PE firms: commercial assessment, revenue quality & deal risk mitigation
